tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer 'khrul med snying po zhes bya ba

bzhugs so// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer 'khrul med snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo| |gang gis mdo rgyud man ngag gnad// snying por dril ba'i gdams pa ni// dam chos lnga ldan zhes grags pa'i// rje yi dgongs pa 'khrul med bri| |rten gyi gang zag gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa dag gis lam 'di bzhin khrid gnad du smin pa mnos nas/ nyams len khrigs chags rgyun 'khyer du bya ba'i tshe/ 'don sgom zung du 'brel ba 'di ltar bya ste/ stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i dben par gnas nas/ ngag tu/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ */byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsum dang*/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /gsum brjod/ dang po byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar spyan drangs/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar phul nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs| |sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/gsum dang*/ slar/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// gsum dang*/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni| |bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur// ces dga' ba sgom zhing smon 'jug gi rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag sdom pa rnams srung sems drag po bskyed la dam bca' zhing lag tu lon par bya'o// gnyis pa yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa ni/ shrī he ru ka ko3haṃ/ gsum brjod/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du mi gnas pa'o// shar du/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hū?m̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lhor| oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi ge rnams g.yon skor du nag ljang dmar ser ba'i kha dog can tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab cing 'bar ba/ de'i 'od zer gyi rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur/

'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba/ gur gyi nang du bla bre dang*/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab par gyur| oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de dag gi 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ 'khor lo'i ra ba zlum po bar mtshams med cing dum bu gcig tu gyur pas rnam pa thams cad du 'gro ba bgegs dang bral ba'o| |oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma pra kā ra hūm̐/ oṃ tsakra pra kā ra hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dkar po phrag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bskor ba'i mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi steng du/ nyi ma la/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya| ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la dmar po phrag gnyis g.yon du bskor ba dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de dag gi bar du rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa 'od 'phro ba rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te thim pas thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de la rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog nag po/ zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa gyen du bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pas spras pa/ dar dpyangs dang rdo rje'i phreng bas sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse phran skra mtshams su bcings pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ rus chen gyi 'khor lo rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdub kor/ ska rags/ thal chen gyis byugs te phyag rgya drug dang gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i bar dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo bltabs te brdzis pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'khyud pa'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can zhal yab dang sbyor ba/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus chen gyi phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa gdengs shing g.yon thod khrag yab kyi mgul du 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas yab kyi brla g.yon nas 'khyud cing*/ g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan cig tu brkyangs pa/ bde ba'i nyams can yab yum bskal pa'i me 'bar ba'i gzi 'od can dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba'i phung po lnga rgyal ba lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ nang gi skye mched drug sems dpa' drug /phyi'i skye mched sems ma drug /tshigs rnams khro bo dang khro mo/ phyi nang gzhan gsum dag pa gdod ma nas yongs su grub pa yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o// de'i dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par pad+ma'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ snying khar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying khar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad du phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ 'bar ba'i rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ pheṃ/ snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra wī ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she= oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge= oṃ badz+ra mu rañdze= oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya= oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya= oṃ badz+ra gī tī= oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+yai= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= oṃ badz+ra dhū pe= oṃ badz+ra dī pe= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe= oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shapad= oṃ ra sa= oṃ spar+she= oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go// dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dbang gi don du/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems mchog bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol| |thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// gsum dang*/

oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ phyag 'tshal/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ gis sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum| |deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spong ngo// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyi gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/

dbang lha'i mdun du dbang rdzas rnams dmigs la/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchog chen ci ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hes bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi rnam shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas bum chu hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ rang gi tshor ba'i phung po dang cod pan aṃ dang rin po che las rin 'byung ser po g.yas rin po che/ rang gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang rdo rje dz+rīṃ dang pad+ma las 'od dpag med dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ rang gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dril bu khaṃ dang ral gri las don grub ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ rang gi gzugs kyi phung po dang rdor dril buṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ lnga ka'ang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge'i 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang rdzas kyi lha rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum rnams kyis dbang gi shis pa brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ yum lngas dbang rdzas so sor bsnams nas/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.oṃ/ oṃ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bum pa dang*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥmu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ gis dbu rgyan dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis rdo rje dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis dril bu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rang rang gi gsang mtshan gang yin brjod/ mchan| zhes ming dbang rnams rang rang gi gnas su bskur/ chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las yab la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga yab yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ rig pa'i dbang lnga thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ rigs lnga'i dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas/ slar yang lha'i thugs kar sngags phreng gsal ba las spros pa/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar g.yon skor du 'khod par gyur/ yum gyi snying po brjod/ dbang lha rdo rje gtad de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ zhes lung bstan/ slar yang dbang lhas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa aḥ zhes dril bu gtad/ 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dbang lhas/ khyod kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi slob dpon gyis shig /ces gnang ba sbyin/ bum pa bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab| bcom ldan 'das yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems 'dres pa rang gi lcer bzhag cing*/ gtso bos spros pa'i lhan skyes snang mtha'i rnam pa rang gi mgrin par thim/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ gtso bo'i yum las spros pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'du shes sum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas bde stong lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa skyes/

de la dbang lhas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes ngo sprad pas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi ye shes bcos min rgyud la skyes/ dbang bzhi po rim gyis thob/ sgrib pa bzhi dag /lam bzhi bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar dbang 'di ni rgyu dus su slob dpon gyis bskur ba de'ang*/ de nyid lam dus su mdor bsdus bdag 'jug nyams su blangs pas dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa zhes sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba yin pas gal che'o// de nas rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bi re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yab dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bi d+yā+e shwa rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod nas/ bskyed rim mtshan nyid gsum ldan la ci gnas su sems bzung nas ngal na sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ pad+ma narte shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bdun nam nyer gcig gis bgrang phreng byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba rlung dang lhan cig tu rang gi sna bug g.yas pa nas thon/ khams gsum gyi sems can lhar gnas pa'i sna bug g.yas par zhugs snying khar hūm̐ gnas par thim zhing*/ hūm̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas sems can gyi sna bug g.yon pa nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yas par zhugs thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim zhing 'khor bar gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab kyi nye snying ngo*| |oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi nye snying ngo// de ltar skyon drug dang bral bas bzlas la/ rdo rje gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas grub tshad bya'o// gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar gyad dang seng ge chen po brgyad brgyad kyi bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la/ ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/

do shal/ ska rags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i pang du/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo/ skra grol ba/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po che du mas brgyan cing*/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum bde ba chen po'i nyams dang ldan zhing*/ thabs shes mnyam par rol pa'i spyi bo'i steng nas steng du brgyud pa'i rim pa rdo rje 'chang bar 'og ma'i steng du gong ma rim gyis tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes 'od dpag med/ 'du byed don yod grub pa/ rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa/ sa'i khams sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu'i khams mā ma kī/ me'i khams gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams dam tshig sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i khams chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ spyan byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ ljags 'jig rten dbang phyug /lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ tshigs kun tu bzang po/ rtsa byams pa/ gzugs snang sogs gzugs rdo rje ma/ sgra rdo rje/ dri rdo rje/ ro rdo rje/ reg bya rdo rje/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma/ phyag g.yas pa gshin rje'i gshed/ g.yon pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ zhal rta mgrin/ rdo rje bdud rtsi thal sbyor/ dpung pa g.yas pa mi g.yo ba/ g.yon 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ rje ngar g.yas pa dbyug sngon can/ g.yon stobs po che/ spyi gtsug 'khor los bsgyur ba/

rkang mthil gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams gdod nas yongs su grub pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa ltos pa med par phul nas rigs kun mas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ bla ma rnams la thim/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang til+li pa la thim pa sogs yas rim nas mar thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar bsdus/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la bum pa'i dbang chu rgyun gcig ma bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa bab/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa dag /sku rdo rje mngon du byas/ yang gong ltar/ gsang dbang zhes gsol ba btab/ byang sems bab pas snying ga yan chad gang*/ rmi lam gyi sgrib pa dag /gsung rdo rje mngon du byas/ yang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi gsol ba btab/ byang sems bab nas lte ba yan chad gang*/ gnyid 'thug gi sgrib pa dag /thugs rdo rje mngon du byas/ yang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i gsol ba btab/ byang sems bab/ gsang gnas yan chad gang*/ 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa dag /ye shes rdo rje mngon du byas/ slar mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang bcas nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba rang gi smin mtshams su thim pas/ tha mal yid chos kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsams la mnyam par bzhag /bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa ni/ don gyi ngo bo bzo med lhug par skyongs/ lnga pa bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa zhig bya dgos te/

thun las ldang ba'i tshe bskyed rim bsdu ba'am ma bsdus kyang rung*/ bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po 'di'i mthu la brten nas lus ngag yid gsum gyis sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig /bdag gi rgyud la nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug /nga rgyal| phrag dog gi bsam pa mi 'byung bar gyur cig /grags pa dang*/ snyan pa dang*/ rnyed pa dang*/ bkur sti/ tshe 'di'i bsam pa skad cig tsam yang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis bdag gi rgyud brlan te yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhig tu gyur nas tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig /bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sogs bsngo smon gang 'grub dmigs med kyi ngang nas bya ba gal che/ rnam rtog gi ngang nas byas na bsngo smon sogs chos spyod rnams ni rnam par dag par mi sems so// smras pa/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan zhes// kun gyis dab dib gleng na yang*// mdo sngags zung 'brel nyams blangs pa// rnam par dag pa nyin skar tsam// rgyas dang bsdus pa mang po yi| |rtsom pa'ang deng sang mang mod kyi// lnga ldan man ngag khrid btab ces// deng sang 'ga' 'ga' mthong thos kyi// mdo sngags tshig don ma thos shing*// rje yi dgongs pa ma rtogs la// rang rig mngon du ma gyur pa'i// ming la zhen pa'i bshes gnyen 'ga'| |dpyad gsum dag pas legs brtag tshe// chu shing bzhin du snying pos dben// tshul 'di mdo sngags don mthong zhing*// gtso bor mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// dgongs don sngon nas rtogs gyur pas// tshig nyung don mang 'gag dril zhing*// mdo sngags mang po'i gnad zab mo// zur tsam ma tshang med pa 'di// rang dang skal mnyam 'ga' 'ga' la// phan snyam 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung*// gnas lugs rtogs pa ngas byas kyi// don gnyis 'grub la smon pa rnams// rnam dag gdams 'di nyams su longs| |khengs drag rnyed brtson la gzhol bas// 'di la'ang phrag dog byed srid kyi// nyes brgya spyad pa'i yi dwags la// zla 'od kyis kyang rab gdungs pa// rang nyes yin gyi gzhan du min// tshul 'di brtsams dang 'ga' zhig gis// nyams su bstar ba'i dge ba kun// ma rgan 'gro drug la sbyin gyi// bdag la phan 'dod sems ma mchis// zhes pa lnga ldan gyi nyams len tshig nyung zhing mdo sngags kyi don mang po tshang zhing*/

mgon po 'bri gung pa'i bzhed pa 'khrul med 'don sgom byed pa'ang dga' zhig 'ong srid pas de rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa dang*/ rin dbang gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rang gi nyams len gyi khrid ji lta bar bris pa'ang*/ 'bri gung pa gsang sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ shing phag nag pa can gyi phyogs phyi ma'i dga' ba dang por/ nges don ston pa'i'adun sa chen po bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig pad+ma 'od du mgyogs par bris pas sems can thams cad la mchog tu sman par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
